coverage: Seven approved metric length units, six fixed-duration units, and the previously approved kilogram. This is not the complete product unit registry. Physical definitions and conversion factors are specified separately.

length.nanometre.meaning: The nanometre, a unit of length.
length.nanometre.context: The Latin symbol is always accepted as a unit token. Its localized counterpart is accepted only when that locale matches the interface language. This notation was approved in expression-language round 13.
length.nanometre.location: Unit positions in mathematical expressions and conversion targets. An explicit conversion preserves the user's target symbol; otherwise the interface-language symbol is used.
